policy_scope: Extension-owned experimental evidence routes only; native D, rank, tier, veto, candidate partitions, filters and preprocessing are read-only.

method_policy.bootstrap_resampling: stratified by lineage and, for conditional dependency, context/reference group
method_policy.lineage_adjustment: Retain lineages with at least 15 evaluable models and subtract each relevant Chronos vector's within-lineage median.
method_policy.leave_one_lineage_out: Fraction of estimable holdouts with sign matching the full adjusted statistic; zero or no estimable holdout is unresolved.
method_policy.model_dependency_support_boundary_label: Provisional descriptive raw Chronos effect boundary inherited from AVI; sensitivity-tested in BR09.
method_policy.conditional_dependency_shift: median(reference adjusted Chronos) - median(context adjusted Chronos); positive means the context group is more target-dependent.
method_policy.rna_context: Within lineage Q80-or-higher source RNA versus Q20-or-lower; middle quintile is not_applicable and a lineage below 15 is unresolved.
method_policy.mutation_reference_label: No qualifying event recorded in a mutation-assayed model; this is not definitive wild type without locus-level callability.

direct_fusion.relationship_shape: unordered canonical Ensembl pair with retained source/target request orientation
direct_fusion.status_policy: supported when at least one exact retained pair call exists; contradicted only when at least one cohort model is demonstrably fusion-assayed and no exact call exists; otherwise unavailable
direct_fusion.model_policy: exact processed pair row=support; fusion-assayed no exact retained pair=conflict; non-assayed=unknown

conditional_dependency.relationship_shape: directional source context to target dependency
conditional_dependency.supported_policy: sample gates pass; target is not common essential; adjusted shift positive; bootstrap lower bound above zero; leave-one-lineage-out sign consistency at least 0.80
conditional_dependency.contradicted_policy: sample gates pass; adjusted shift negative; bootstrap upper bound below zero; leave-one-lineage-out sign consistency at least 0.80
conditional_dependency.exploratory_policy: estimable but interval/stability uncertain, or target common essential; common-essential is never route-qualified
conditional_dependency.unavailable_policy: identity, required assay, group size, total size or two-lineage requirement fails
conditional_dependency.model_policy: context-positive measured QC-usable target Chronos <= -0.5=support; measured above boundary=conflict; reference/middle=not_applicable; absent/QC-unusable=unknown

crispr_codependency.relationship_shape: unordered canonical Ensembl pair with retained source/target request orientation
crispr_codependency.statistic: raw and lineage-median-adjusted Spearman rho over shared measured QC-usable models
crispr_codependency.supported_policy: cohort gates pass; neither gene common essential; adjusted bootstrap interval excludes zero; leave-one-lineage-out sign consistency at least 0.80
crispr_codependency.exploratory_policy: estimable but interval/stability uncertain, or a common-essential warning applies
crispr_codependency.unavailable_policy: a vector, shared cohort, lineage count or variance is insufficient
crispr_codependency.contradicted_policy: not used for negative rho without a future pre-registered directional hypothesis
crispr_codependency.model_policy: both raw effects <= -0.5=support; exactly one=neutral; neither=conflict; missing/QC/lineage failure=unknown

sources.purpose: Model identity, lineage and QC/problematic state.
Canonical Ensembl identity resolution only; unresolved or ambiguous symbols are rejected.
Distinguish observed, measured_absent and not_assayed evidence.
Measured source RNA for within-lineage RNA-high context.
Measured, QC-usable Chronos target effects and shared codependency vectors.
Exact retained fusion calls and their separate technical fields.
Target-selectivity gate/warning; universal essentiality is not selective route evidence.
Read-only native D, rank, tier, veto, roles and filters attached as context without recomputation.
Disclosure-only relative copy number; no absolute-copy-number threshold is permitted.
Molecular evidence/context only, not a first-release route input.

evidence_ledger.csv_policy: One evidence item per row; formula-safe text on export.
evidence_ledger.json_policy: Authoritative complete strict JSON export with finite-number handling.

prohibited_claims: Route evidence does not change native D, rank, tier, veto, candidate partition, filter or preprocessing output.
Do not aggregate values across route families into a score or ranking.
Do not describe a correlation as causal, mechanistic, a physical interaction, synthetic lethality, tumour similarity, proof of suitability or a recommendation.
Do not convert missing or not-assayed evidence to zero or a biological negative.
Do not call a mutation reference group definitive wild type without locus-level callability.
Do not create a fusion probability or hidden combined score from technical fusion fields.
Validation-only sources are retrospective corroboration only and cannot train, qualify or supply route evidence.

persistence_policy.attachment_key: deterministic relationship ID plus policy version
persistence_policy.post: Explicit idempotent evaluation against an immutable research snapshot.
persistence_policy.ui: Optional relationship form and separate route panel; never alters native rank column or table order.
